exposure: type of surgery (cesarean delivery vs. gynecologic surgery)
patient education on sequential compression device use
nursing education on sequential compression device use
cohort: English-speaking patients who underwent cesarean delivery or benign gynecologic surgery and were prescribed to wear sequential compression devices postoperatively at a university medical center
finding: Compliance with postoperative use of sequential compression devices was approximately 58% and did not improve with patient or nursing educational interventions.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with the lowest rate of compliance when compared with gynecologic surgeries.
